subject: integration
name: Orivon passwords
summary: Built-in Crypto that answers the browser's saved-login code. It holds no password and opens no connection: it passes list, reveal, save and remove calls to the vault Accounts it is given, the built-in one on this computer and any the person installed, each judged on its own. Only the browser's own password door may call it, and a call naming an Account that cannot answer is denied, never handed to another. Level 4 with privacy; it would drop if it reached a server itself. Judged here by its publisher.
